# Dashboard Real Data Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace static mock data in the Dashboard with real data generated by the system, tracking user queries, topics, and document ingestion status using SQLite/PostgreSQL.

**Architecture:** We add `QueryLog` and `Document` models to SQLAlchemy. `POST /api/chat` inserts into `QueryLog` and categorizes the topic using a new rule-based analytics service. The `ingestion/ingest_doc.py` script creates/updates `Document` models. A new `GET /api/dashboard/metrics` endpoint computes aggregations and serves them to the React frontend.

**Tech Stack:** FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (asyncio), Vite/React, Tailwind CSS.

```python
# Add to backend/app/db/models.py
from sqlalchemy import Integer, ForeignKey

class QueryLog(Base):
    __tablename__ = "query_logs"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), index=True)
    query_text: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(4000))
    topic: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), index=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )

class Document(Base):
    __tablename__ = "documents"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), unique=True, index=True)
    chunk_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(20))
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True),
        default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        onupdate=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )
```

Create `backend/app/services/analytics.py`:

```python
import re

TOPIC_RULES = [
    (re.compile(r"retention|lưu trữ|xóa|delete", re.IGNORECASE), "Data Retention"),
    (re.compile(r"third.?party|bên thứ ba|share|chia sẻ", re.IGNORECASE), "Third-Party Sharing"),
    (re.compile(r"cookie|tracker|theo dõi", re.IGNORECASE), "Cookies"),
    (re.compile(r"sell|bán|opt.?out", re.IGNORECASE), "Data Sale / Opt-out"),
]

def classify_topic(query: str) -> str:
    for pattern, topic in TOPIC_RULES:
        if pattern.search(query):
            return topic
    return "Other"
```

### Task 3: Integrate Query Logging into Chat Endpoint

**Files:**
- Modify: `backend/app/api/chat.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Modify Implementation directly**

We will update the `_generate` function to handle DB logic, bypassing test creation first due to the complex generator mocking involved, but we will test it end-to-end afterwards.

Modify `backend/app/api/chat.py`:

Add imports at the top:
```python
from backend.app.db.session import _session_factory
from backend.app.db.models import QueryLog
from backend.app.services.analytics import classify_topic
```

Update `chat_endpoint`:
```python
    async def _generate() -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
        # Track query start
        topic = classify_topic(body.message)
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            log = QueryLog(user_id=current_user.id, query_text=body.message, topic=topic, status="processing")
            session.add(log)
            await session.commit()
            log_id = log.id

        try:
            if is_conflict_query(body.message):
                generator = rag.stream_conflict_answer(body.message, history, source_filter=body.source_filter)
            else:
                generator = rag.stream_answer(body.message, history, source_filter=body.source_filter)
            
            async for event in generator:
                yield f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n\n"
                if event.get("type") == "error":
                    async with _session_factory() as session:
                        err_log = await session.get(QueryLog, log_id)
                        if err_log:
                            err_log.status = "error"
                            await session.commit()
                    return

            async with _session_factory() as session:
                success_log = await session.get(QueryLog, log_id)
                if success_log:
                    success_log.status = "success"
                    await session.commit()
                    
        except Exception:
            async with _session_factory() as session:
                fail_log = await session.get(QueryLog, log_id)
                if fail_log:
                    fail_log.status = "error"
                    await session.commit()
            raise

    return StreamingResponse(_generate(), media_type="text/event-stream")
```

Create `backend/app/api/dashboard.py`:
```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy import select, func, desc
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

from backend.app.db.session import get_db
from backend.app.db.models import User, QueryLog, Document
from backend.app.services.auth import get_current_user

router = APIRouter()

@router.get("/dashboard/metrics")
async def get_dashboard_metrics(
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    # Total Policies & Indexed Chunks
    docs = (await db.execute(select(Document).order_by(desc(Document.updated_at)))).scalars().all()
    total_policies = len(docs)
    indexed_chunks = sum(d.chunk_count for d in docs)
    
    # Queries Today
    today_start = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    yesterday_start = today_start - timedelta(days=1)
    
    queries_today = (await db.execute(
        select(func.count(QueryLog.id)).where(QueryLog.created_at >= today_start)
    )).scalar() or 0
    
    queries_yesterday = (await db.execute(
        select(func.count(QueryLog.id))
        .where(QueryLog.created_at >= yesterday_start)
        .where(QueryLog.created_at < today_start)
    )).scalar() or 0
    
    increase = queries_today - queries_yesterday
    sub_text = f"{'+' if increase >= 0 else ''}{increase} vs yesterday"
    
    # Recent Queries
    recent = (await db.execute(
        select(QueryLog).order_by(desc(QueryLog.created_at)).limit(5)
    )).scalars().all()
    
    # Top Topics
    top_topics_res = (await db.execute(
        select(QueryLog.topic, func.count(QueryLog.id).label("count"))
        .group_by(QueryLog.topic)
        .order_by(desc("count"))
        .limit(5)
    )).all()
    
    return {
        "totalPolicies": total_policies,
        "indexedChunks": indexed_chunks,
        "queriesToday": queries_today,
        "queriesTodaySub": sub_text,
        "recentQueries": [{"time": q.created_at.isoformat(), "query": q.query_text, "status": q.status} for q in recent],
        "topTopics": [{"topic": r[0], "count": r[1]} for r in top_topics_res],
        "ingestionStatuses": [
            {"id": str(d.id), "name": d.title, "chunks": d.chunk_count, "status": d.status.lower()} 
            for d in docs[:4]
        ]
    }
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTheme } from "@/lib/theme";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { fetchWithAuth } from "@/lib/api";
import type { Screen } from "@/components/layout/AppShell";

export function DashboardScreen({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate: (s: Screen) => void }) {
  const { t, accent } = useTheme();
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      try {
        const res = await fetchWithAuth("/api/dashboard/metrics");
        const json = await res.json();
        setData(json);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
    loadData();
  }, []);

  if (error) {
    return <div style={{ padding: 32, color: "red" }}>Error loading dashboard: {error}</div>;
  }

  if (!data) {
    return <div style={{ padding: 32, color: t.muted }}>Loading dashboard data...</div>;
  }

  const kpis = [
    { label: "Total Policies",    value: String(data.totalPolicies), sub: "Tracked in DB" },
    { label: "Indexed Chunks",    value: data.indexedChunks.toLocaleString(), sub: "across all docs" },
    { label: "Queries Today",     value: String(data.queriesToday), sub: data.queriesTodaySub },
    { label: "Citation Coverage", value: "98.2%", sub: "Hardcoded for now" }, // Keeping one hardcoded
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: "32px 36px", maxWidth: 1100, margin: "0 auto", overflowY: "auto", height: "100%" }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 28 }}>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 700, color: t.text, margin: 0 }}>Dashboard</h1>
        <p style={{ fontSize: 13, color: t.muted, marginTop: 4 }}>System overview</p>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(4,1fr)", gap: 16, marginBottom: 28 }}>
        {kpis.map((k, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{ background: t.surface, border: `1px solid ${t.border}`, borderRadius: 8, padding: "20px 22px" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, color: t.faint, letterSpacing: "0.06em", textTransform: "uppercase", marginBottom: 10 }}>{k.label}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 700, color: t.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>{k.value}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: t.muted }}>{k.sub}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Recent Queries + Top Topics */}
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 300px", gap: 20, marginBottom: 20 }}>
        {/* Recent Queries */}
        <div style={{ background: t.surface, border: `1px solid ${t.border}`, borderRadius: 8, overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px", borderBottom: `1px solid ${t.border2}`, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: t.text }}>Recent Queries</span>
            <button onClick={() => onNavigate("audit")} style={{ fontSize: 12, color: accent, background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 500 }}>View all →</button>
          </div>
          {data.recentQueries.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ padding: "12px 20px", fontSize: 13, color: t.muted }}>No recent queries.</div>
          )}
          {data.recentQueries.map((a: any, i: number) => {
            const timeStr = new Date(a.time).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            return (
              <div key={i} style={{ padding: "12px 20px", borderBottom: i < data.recentQueries.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${t.border2}` : "none", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12 }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: t.faint, fontFamily: "monospace", minWidth: 40 }}>{timeStr}</span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: t.text2, flex: 1 }}>{a.query}</span>
                <Badge status={a.status === "success" ? "completed" : a.status === "error" ? "failed" : "processing"} />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Top Topics */}
        <div style={{ background: t.surface, border: `1px solid ${t.border}`, borderRadius: 8, overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px", borderBottom: `1px solid ${t.border2}` }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: t.text }}>Top Queried Topics</span>
          </div>
          {data.topTopics.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ padding: "12px 20px", fontSize: 13, color: t.muted }}>No topics yet.</div>
          )}
          {data.topTopics.map((tp: any, i: number) => {
            const maxCount = Math.max(...data.topTopics.map((t: any) => t.count), 1);
            return (
              <div key={i} style={{ padding: "12px 20px", borderBottom: i < data.topTopics.length - 1 ? `1px solid ${t.border2}` : "none" }}>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: t.text2 }}>{tp.topic}</span>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: t.muted }}>{tp.count}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ height: 4, background: t.border, borderRadius: 2, overflow: "hidden" }}>
                  <div style={{ width: `${(tp.count / maxCount) * 100}%`, height: "100%", background: accent, borderRadius: 2 }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ingestion Status */}
      <div style={{ background: t.surface, border: `1px solid ${t.border}`, borderRadius: 8, overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <div style={{ padding: "16px 20px", borderBottom: `1px solid ${t.border2}`, display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: t.text }}>Policy Ingestion Status</span>
          <button onClick={() => onNavigate("library")} style={{ fontSize: 12, color: accent, background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: 500 }}>Manage library →</button>
        </div>
        {data.ingestionStatuses.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ padding: "14px 20px", fontSize: 13, color: t.muted }}>No documents ingested yet.</div>
        )}
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(4,1fr)" }}>
          {data.ingestionStatuses.map((p: any, i: number) => (
            <div key={p.id} style={{ padding: "14px 20px", borderRight: i < 3 ? `1px solid ${t.border2}` : "none" }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: t.text, marginBottom: 4 }}>
                {p.name.replace(" Privacy Policy", "").replace(" Privacy Statement", "")}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: t.faint, marginBottom: 8 }}>{p.chunks} chunks</div>
              <Badge status={p.status === "completed" ? "completed" : p.status === "failed" ? "failed" : "processing"} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
